title: Multiple leaks reveal gameplay, map, and details of GTA 6 as Rockstar issues takedowns
summary: A wave of leaks shows mechanics, map extent, and gameplay systems of Grand Theft Auto 6, sparking debate about its ambition and Rockstar's legal response.

title: Warren Spector, creator of Deus Ex and pioneer of immersive sims, announces retirement after 40 years
summary: The legendary designer hangs up his keyboard leaving three projects undone, but celebrates having fulfilled his creative vision in the industry.

title: Phantom Blade Zero showcases its interconnected world and combat in new trailer with October release
summary: The Chinese action-RPG reveals hand-painted maps, guided exploration, and deep combat mechanics in its most comprehensive presentation to date.

title: Xbox Game Pass announces its August 2026 wave with nine free games and six departures from the catalog
summary: Microsoft reveals the titles arriving to the service late this month, including Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy and Vapor World, while The Witcher 3 leaves the library.

title: Shuhei Yoshida advised Expedition 33 creators not to label it as 'turn-based RPG' to avoid prejudice
summary: The former PlayStation executive revealed he urged the studio to avoid the term for fear players would overlook a niche genre.

title: Control Resonant confirms imminent launch but physical version delayed indefinitely
summary: The action RPG is ready for digital release, but the disc edition has no date due to production issues.

title: Bethesda announces patches for Fallout 4 and Skyrim; players fear they will break mods and stability
summary: Next-gen updates arrive with community warnings about incompatibilities with existing modifications.

title: Tomb Raider remake to add skill trees, crafting, and focus meter, generating backlash among fans
summary: The modernization of the classic introduces RPG mechanics that many consider unnecessary and foreign to the original spirit of the series.

title: Warren Spector expresses bitterness because his studio receives no credit for the return of Oswald the Lucky Rabbit
summary: The creator of Epic Mickey laments that Disney and the press ignore Junction Point's role in reviving the classic Disney character.

title: Battlefield 6 launches free trial coinciding with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 beta
summary: EA schedules early access to its shooter to compete directly with Activision's rival trial this weekend.

title: Trainwatch, a life, horror, and time management simulator on a train, to be published by 11 bit studios
summary: The game combines observation of unsettling landscapes, resource management, and mystery narrative on railway journeys.

title: TMNT: Splintered Fate receives 2.0 update with new final boss and playable character Slash
summary: The Ninja Turtles roguelike concludes its main story and adds content in its largest update to date.

title: Trails in the Sky 1st Chapter releases 'Legacy' patch with graphical, performance, and quality-of-life improvements
summary: Update 1.07 modernizes the classic JRPG with speed options, fixes, and visual improvements across all platforms.
